info.title: Salesforce MCP Server
info.description: Read Salesforce data (and optionally change it) from Copilot Studio through an MCP server you host on Azure Container Apps. The server calls the Salesforce REST API directly. It does not use the Salesforce-hosted MCP servers.

post.description: Passes MCP JSON-RPC traffic through to the Salesforce MCP server. Tools are discovered at runtime with tools/list, so a server-side change to the tool set needs no connector change.
